content: This highlights that IT vendors must be prepared to meet specific grading criteria when bidding for public sector contracts that integrate technological solutions into physical infrastructure. However, much of the available information on specific IT tender categories can quickly become outdated, emphasizing the time-sensitive nature of tender data from aggregation sites. The official portal for the Construction Industry Development Board highlights general tender categories, including current and awarded tenders, but often lacks explicit IT-related classifications in its primary views [62] . Furthermore, resources such as the Tender Bulletin provide general formats but often feature historical listings, reflecting the ongoing need for up-to-date materials to address evolving classifications and active tenders [64] . Other platforms, such as Simpletender.co.za, aggregate nationwide listings and serve as gateways to broader content, though they may not provide detailed IT tender classifications. In addition to grading requirements, successful participation in South African government tenders mandates strict compliance with the Central Supplier Database registration requirements. The Central Supplier Database serves as a mandatory platform for all suppliers aiming to conduct business with the South African government, consolidating all supplier information into a single, centralized registry [65] . The absence of granular, IT-specific guidance underscores the need for IT vendors to actively review and confirm requirements via updated and official systems to ensure full alignment with industry-specific government tender regulations [61][63][64] . These audits indirectly benefit IT vendors seeking tender opportunities by ensuring their registration details perfectly align with South African procurement standards before a bid is submitted. By maintaining an active, fully compliant profile on the Central Supplier Database and continuously monitoring the Construction Industry Development Board for infrastructure-linked IT tenders, companies can significantly enhance their competitive posture. Firms must remain vigilant, as past registration deadlines and procedural shifts in related sectors demonstrate that government procurement landscapes are subject to administrative updates [62] .
